note: flags from an independent visual reviewer who looked at the compare images

flags.problem: Flat logo posterised with blobby, stair-stepped contours at 1:1; thin snake-hair strands thicken and merge into the black mass, so the design silhouette drifts from the original.
flags.fix: Keep hair strands thin: trace contours at higher resolution with less gaussian smoothing (gs 2 to 0.5-1) and keep the hard cut-out edge crisp; check the red ring stays a clean continuous line.

flags.problem: Heavy high-frequency lab-inject grain at 1:1 reads as film noise/sandpaper; orange-brown rivet dots turn into pale blobs and lose their colour.
flags.fix: Reduce the grain amplitude (sigma t/48 injection) and restore rivet hue by colour-matching the rivet pixels back to the original palette.

flags.problem: At 1:1 the centre crop shows horizontal smearing/streaking across the panel, reading as a directional scan artifact and softening the recessed panel bevels.
flags.fix: Find the directional filter (sharpen or lab-inject kernel) causing the horizontal smear and switch to isotropic detail injection; keep bevel edges crisp.

flags.problem: At 1:1 the rivet/port area shows horizontal streak banding and a smeared look, not isotropic metal detail; the fine grain overlay adds to it.
flags.fix: Remove the horizontal streaking (check the sharpen pass for directional bias) and reduce or make isotropic the Metal010 grain overlay.
